text: The lab builds its training data from the classic chaotic Lorenz system via lorenz_rk4. Which set of parameter values (sigma, rho, beta) puts the system on its canonical strange attractor?
explanation: The canonical chaotic Lorenz parameters are sigma=10, rho=28, beta=8/3 (the defaults in lorenz_rk4 and the values stated in the book). Option 0 swaps sigma and rho; option 3 mislabels rho and beta; option 1 (all ones) is not chaotic because rho is far below the onset of chaos. At the canonical values the attractor has fractal dimension ~2.05 and lambda_max ~0.906.
